subject: tu:game/pb/pb_frame
value: DATA GATE PARTLY CLOSED for game/pb/pb_frame (40.0% -> 60.0%); the REMAINDER IS NOT INDEPENDENTLY FIXABLE and is gated on the code straggler. CAUSE 1, FIXED: pb_frame's splits.txt entry claimed only extab/extabindex/.text, so the extracted target object had NO .data and NO .sdata2 at all while our object emitted .data 0x1C and .sdata2 0x20 - datadiff reported these as 'object emits 0x1C but nothing claimed'. That phrasing is the tell: the data was UNCLAIMED, not absent. Both objects were then located in the retail DOL by direct byte search and are genuinely pb_frame's: a 7-entry switch jump table at 0x80128158..0x80128174 whose seven words are all addresses inside pb_frame's own .text, and a 4-literal FP pool at 0x80348F18..0x80348F38 byte-identical to the pool our object emits. Adding the two splits.txt lines took both sections to 100%. NOTE the prior capped record attempt.pb-frame-mode-structural-closure.20260831.v3 screened 'lbl_80348F18 is a dead declaration, zero FP-pool read sites' and moved on; the declaration at pb_frame.c:226 IS dead, but the ADDRESS is not - it is the head of pb_frame's real .sdata2 pool, which the TU emits through compiler-generated @NNN literals rather than through that extern. A dead source declaration is not evidence that the address is unowned. CAUSE 2, THE REMAINING BLOCKER: extabindex, 72 of the TU's now-180 data bytes, sits at 98.61111% and contributes zero. The diff is exactly ONE WORD - at extabindex+0x1C the target holds 00000ef8 and ours 00000efc. That field is pbFrameMode's function SIZE (3832 vs 3836): our .text is 0x1EE4 against the target's 0x1EE0 because pbFrameMode compiles one instruction long (959 vs 958). extabindex is generated from function extents, so it is a pure DOWNSTREAM CONSEQUENCE of the code residual and no data-side edit can close it. CONSEQUENCE FOR PLANNING: pb_frame cannot reach 100% data, and therefore cannot flip, until pbFrameMode goes exact; conversely closing pbFrameMode closes extabindex automatically and takes the TU to 100% data in the same step. pbFrameMode remains under its same-day cap (attempt.pb-frame-mode-structural-closure.20260831.v3, MIXED, best real 389) and was NOT re-probed this run.
